description: This file contains the implementation of the TransactionalState<TState> class, which manages stateful transactions within the Orleans framework, including methods for performing read/write operations, state setup, and lifecycle participation.

classes.name: TransactionalState<TState>
classes.description: A class representing a transactional stateful grain component that supports Orleans transaction semantics, including read/write operations and lifecycle management.

methods.name: PerformRead<TResult>
methods.description: Performs a read operation within a transaction, acquiring lock and handling reentrancy.

methods.name: PerformUpdate<TResult>
methods.description: Performs an update operation within a transaction, including state copying and concurrency control.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the object to lifecycle events for setup.

methods.name: OnSetupState
methods.description: Initializes transaction queue and resources, and recovers state.

methods.name: CopyResult<TResult>
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the result using registered data copiers.
